issues.description: The exercise and template require a subroutine named 'set_pixel', but the solution implements the pixel-writing routine under a different name ('write_pixel') while still calling 'set_pixel' from main. Specifically: the problem statement and template expect/declare 'set_pixel' (problem_statement.md lines 29-33; template pixel.asm lines 36-38), the solution defines 'write_pixel' (solution pixel.asm lines 19-34) and the solution's main still contains a call to 'set_pixel' (solution pixel.asm line 147). This naming mismatch breaks the one-to-one mapping students expect, and in practice will cause assembly/link-time errors or undefined symbol behavior because the expected 'set_pixel' label is not defined in the solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the subroutine name consistent across all artifacts. Rename the solution's 'write_pixel' label to 'set_pixel' (preserving its implementation and register conventions), or add a small 'set_pixel' wrapper label that forwards to 'write_pixel'. Also update any comments so the template, problem statement and solution consistently refer to the same symbol ('set_pixel').
